newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks hit another year high of 752.29.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks hit another year high of 752.29.

text.p: Seoul stocks recorded another intraday year high of 752.29 in early afternoon trading on Friday, underpinned by investors optimism over the nation's economy and falling interest rates, brokers said.
The main index gained 9.79 points about 30 minutes after the afternoon session opened. The previous intraday yearly high was 749.37 on Thursday.
Cha Hee-gun of Sunkyong Securities said better-than-expected economic indicators help boost investors sentiment.
Industrial output in April rose 10.7 percent year-on-year, up from an 8.4 percent rise a year earlier.
Inflation, gauged by the consumer price index, rose 3.8 percent in May on the year, down from a 5.1 percent rise a year earlier. The May rise was the lowest monthly increase in 10 years.
"Economic improvement is a major theme to move the market," Cha said.
Park said the market would consolidate at around 750 to absorb looming selling pressure. -- Yeom Yoon-jeong (822) 727 5647
